study type: Prospective cohort study with a case-control component
exposure: vaginal microbiota (analyzed by 16S ribosomal RNA sequence method)
cohort: 64 pregnant women, consisting of 47 with threatened premature labor and 17 with other diseases (non-threatened premature labor).
finding: Increased positivity of Ureaplasma species in vaginal microbiota was a predictive and risk factor for preterm delivery among women with threatened premature labor.
